name: splash-critters
description: Splash Critters: an 8-bit online water-balloon arena battler

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @splash/server" "npm run dev -w @splash/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @splash/client && npm run build -w @splash/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p packages/server --noEmit && tsc -p packages/client --noEmit
